propositions: A dedicated DC summary executor client must be constructed with max_retries=0 and reject nonzero session values, preserving legacy client construction

Each selected write invocation must issue exactly GET/PUT/GET without hidden repeats, with initial GET faults classified as retryable or permanent and PUT faults ending in commit_unknown without read-back
A successful PUT followed by read-back GET outcome is applied only when observed summary equals intended summary; otherwise or if GET fails, outcome is commit_unknown and no auto-replay occurs

After ambiguous PUT, a separate single-attempt GET observation mapped through decide_replay recovers if observed summary matches intended value, permits replay if conclusive old state differs, or returns non-replaying commit_unknown if GET fails
Injected one-attempt wrapper policy performs no sleep and preserves legacy wrapper defaults for non-selected calls

Every DC terminal or exhausted outcome must emit exactly one redacted completion log with logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and single message capped at 512 Unicode code points; total log serialization at most 1,024 Unicode code points
